title: 프랜차이즈·타이틀 전략 SVP
raw:
About Crunchyroll

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

About the role

Crunchyroll is seeking an SVP, Franchise & Title Strategy to transform great anime titles into enduring global franchises that deepen fandom over a lifetime.

Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, this leader takes the baton after content has been acquired, shaping how titles are nurtured, prioritized, and activated across the Crunchyroll ecosystem. This role does not acquire or license content; it partners closely with the Chief Content Officer once titles enter the Crunchyroll portfolio to maximize their long-term potential.

The SVP, Franchise & Title Strategy will bring together Strategy, Marketing, Commercial lines of business, and Regional teams around a unified view of the portfolio—ensuring priority titles have clear franchise ambitions, the right level of investment, and coordinated activation across markets and fan touchpoints. 

The goal is to turn exceptional stories into lasting relationships with fans and build franchises that can grow far beyond a single season or release.

Core Areas of Responsibility

Franchise & Portfolio Strategy

  • Lead Crunchyroll's global franchise strategy, defining how priority titles are developed into enduring franchises.
  • Establish franchise priorities, investment levels, and multi-year plans informed by fan insights, market opportunities, and performance.
  • Identify opportunities to extend franchises across Crunchyroll's businesses and deepen fan engagement throughout their lifecycle.

Global Title Marketing

  • Lead the Title Marketing Strategy function, setting the strategic direction and priorities for major releases.
  • Partner with Regional GMs and Marketing teams to translate global title strategies into locally relevant campaig
